jobs.title: Partner Applied AI Engineer, Oracle and Cloud ISV
jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI Engineering team helps developers and enterprises deploy generative AI safely and effectively. We serve as trusted technical advisors, helping customers and partners move from early experimentation to production-scale AI systems. As a Partner Applied AI Engineer focused on Cloud ISVs, you will work with Oracle Cloud, Snowflake, and Databricks to help customers adopt OpenAI. You will bring OpenAI capabilities to the applications, data platforms, and developer workflows customers already use, then turn successful deployments into approaches the field and partner teams can deliver independently. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced technical leader to work with partner architects, AI specialists, and sales teams across three distinct routes to market. You will lead technical work from joint account discovery and architecture through evaluation and production, alongside OpenAI account teams and partner sellers. You will help customers choose the right deployment and purchasing path for the workload, with clear ownership of security, billing, support, and operations. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: Strategic partner engagement and influence - Build relationships with Oracle, Snowflake, and Databricks field leaders and technical teams. Shape joint account plans, identify the customer problem each partner can help solve, and prioritize opportunities with a clear path to production and reuse. - Oracle Cloud: Work with Oracle sellers on eligible, sales-managed Oracle Marketplace private offers for OpenAI API models, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. Distinguish procurement, billing, and eligible commitment drawdown from OpenAI-managed product access, inference, and support. Where customers build on OCI, design the application and data integration without assuming the model is hosted on OCI. - Snowflake: Work with Snowflake account and technical teams to qualify data and AI workloads where OpenAI models in Snowflake Cortex AI are a fit. Help customers evaluate use cases such as AI functions over governed data, search, analytics, and agents. Confirm model and regional availability, data boundaries, and operating requirements. Distinguish Snowflake-metered Cortex usage from a customer application that calls OpenAI directly. - Databricks: Work with Databricks sellers and solution architects on three joint plays: developer workflows with Codex and Unity AI Gateway, enterprise insights with ChatGPT and Genie where supported, and GPT-powered applications and agents with Mosaic AI Model Serving, Agent Bricks, and Databricks Apps. Validate each route against the customer’s governance and deployment requirements. Distinguish Databricks-billed usage from direct OpenAI billing and confirm commercial eligibility and attribution before making commitments. Complex deal leadership and execution - Lead technical discovery, architecture, prototyping, evaluation, and production readiness. Agree with both account teams on what the customer will deploy, how success will be verified, and who owns the next step. - Validate model and feature availability, identity and network boundaries, data handling and residency, capacity, metering, and support ownership. Work with Alliances, Sales, and Billing Ops on technical readiness without taking ownership of pricing, terms, offer acceptance, or billing approvals. Solution architecture and hands-on building - Build reference implementations with OpenAI APIs and partner-native capabilities, such as OCI application and data services, Snowflake Cortex AI, and Databricks Mosaic AI Model Serving. Use the appropriate integration path for the workload and validate permissions and data movement before deployment. - Put evaluation, observability, and deployment practices in place to measure quality, safety, reliability, latency, cost, and real workload usage. Ecosystem enablement and scale - Create demos, workshops, reference architectures, and playbooks that partner engineers, field teams, and systems integrators can use independently. Pair on early deployments, then hand off proven patterns with clear prerequisites and support paths. Cross-functional leadership and feedback - Work with Alliances, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Enablement to resolve blockers. Turn patterns across accounts into specific product feedback backed by evidence, and keep field guidance current on what is supported, what is limited, and what is not yet available. YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have substantial experience leading technical engagements with enterprise engineering and business leaders across pre- and post-sales. - Have hands-on depth in at least one of OCI, Snowflake, or Databricks and can build credible architectures across the others. You understand enterprise data governance and know how to integrate OpenAI products into production systems. - Can build in Python or a comparable language and have practical experience with APIs, retrieval, tool use, LLM evaluation, and secure cloud deployments. - Can explain how a workload is purchased, accessed, served, metered, and supported without conflating those decisions. You build trust across sales and engineering, and measure success through customer adoption and partner self-sufficiency. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Able to develop solutions to routine technical problems of limited scope Comprehensive understanding of protocol requirements. Organizational, project management, problem-solving, as well as validation protocol, and technical writing capability Excellent communication (verbal/written) and presentation skills Demonstrated interpersonal skills including; collaboration, influencing, and facilitation Protocol and script testing Writing Dealing with and handling change Packaging Equipment Technical knowledge Analytical Problem Solving Comprehensive understanding of validation protocol implementation requirements as well as knowledge of validation processes and requirements as applied to new equipment installations Understanding of Operational Excellence and Lean Transformation in the Automation and Engineering Context What you can expect of us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. cold_email.subject: Interest in IM Product specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the IM Product specialist opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Lead Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: POS-P2935 Lead Solutions Engineer AI is changing how businesses buy. Buyers arrive informed, often having researched with AI, and they no longer buy on promises: they want to see their own business running in HubSpot, and proof that it will deliver measurable results, before they commit. HubSpot's agentic customer platform is leading this shift, connecting customer context, Breeze AI agents and a unified CRM so scaling companies realize business outcomes, not just adopt software. As buying moves from large contracts signed up front to proving value one use case at a time, we are building a new technical go-to-market team to lead customers through that change. Come join the team defining what technical go-to-market looks like in the AI era. As a Solutions Engineer, you bring a customer-facing background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting, along with hands-on building experience. You won't just show customers what's possible; you'll build it with them, prove it delivers their outcomes, and set them on the path to realizing them. This is a pre-sales role, not a software engineering role, for technologists who build fast with AI tools. Few companies have figured out how to sell this way at scale, and here you will help lead the industry in defining and building a new technical go-to-market model that others will follow. If you love building, thrive at the intersection of business and technology, and want to help write the playbook for how software is bought next, this role is for you. In this role, you will need to: Tell compelling, outcome-led stories (via demos and product led experiences) that show customers how their business can be reimagined on HubSpot's agentic customer platform. Lead discovery that uncovers the pain, outcomes and requirements by engaging customers and then earning the right to go deeper Partner with Account Executives to map the technical buying committee, competitive landscape and path to a decision. Redesign customers' legacy complexity into a simplified HubSpot architecture that integrates with their wider tech stack. Design and build working proofs quickly with AI coding tools, Breeze AI agents and the HubSpot developer framework, scoped to clear use cases, success criteria and timelines. Run hands-on proofs with customers, iterating on their feedback and clearing security and integration risks to secure the technical win. Turn proof into a business case, ROI and use-case roadmap with a consumption plan that sizes the first commitment. Present results to executives and generate confidence to move forward with HubSpot Guide and build with customers and implementation partners to ensure the realization of the customer’s first outcomes. Create reusable assets and capture field feedback to shape our playbooks and the HubSpot product roadmap Occasional travel to customer sites to perform the above activities Success measurement: This role will be measured on our ability to win new customers and ensure that the customer achieves their initial business outcomes We are looking for people who (skills and experience): Experience: Customer-facing background in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting or implementation for SaaS platforms, with a track record of winning complex deals or delivering solutions that moved business results. Art-of-the-Possible Storytelling & Discovery: Ability to turn a customer's goals into a compelling, outcome-led vision of their business reimagined in HubSpot, backed by peer proof rather than features. Skilled at uncovering the pain, outcomes and requirements customers don't state outright, through sharp questioning and by reading how they react to what they see. Solution Building & Proof Design: Hands-on fluency building working solutions fast with leading AI coding tools, Breeze AI agents and the HubSpot developer framework. Sound judgment about what proof a deal needs and how to make it measurable, time-boxed and reusable in implementation. Solution Architecture & HubSpot Platform Depth: Ability to simplify legacy complexity into a scalable HubSpot solution and architecture that integrates appropriately with a customer's tech stack (ERP, billing, data warehouse, AI tools, etc.). Deep comfort with enterprise solution architecture, APIs, integrations and AI coding. Consumption Planning & Outcome Ownership: Business acumen to translate outcomes into a use-case roadmap, consumption plan and ROI model. An owner's mindset that guides and builds with the customer to ensure that outcomes are realized. Executive Influence & Orchestration: Credibility with executives and technical buyers to generate excitement in the future vision and the confidence to move forward as well as equip champions to sell internally. Ability to lead without authority across sellers, partners and customer teams. We have several roles open at different levels within this team within our Mid-Market and Corp segments. During the process, if we believe your experience may align more closely with another level/segment, we’ll discuss this with you and outline potential next steps. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. jobs.title: MES Engineer IT Systems
jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Position Summary: The MES Product Owner for Breyanzi is accountable for the end-to-end Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solution supporting the Breyanzi (CAR T cell therapy) manufacturing process at BMS, Bothell. This individual serves as the process and product expert who translates Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain requirements into clear, buildable specifications for MES engineers, leads a sub-team that includes junior and offshore engineers, and ensures that the resulting electronic batch records (EBRs) are compliant, efficient and inspection-ready. The role also acts as the sprint manager for the Breyanzi book of work, leading Agile delivery in Jira and reporting project status to stakeholders. The role requires hands-on MES experience (Syncade preferred), ownership of production deviations and CAPAs related to Breyanzi, and participation in the on-call rotation for L2 escalations. Must ensure GMP-regulated documentation processes and procedures are in place for all activities to meet quality and compliance standards. The candidate should have at least 5 years of experience in pharma/biotech, with specific expertise in Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain systems and in Computer System Validation (CSV). Hands-on Breyanzi process knowledge is a strong advantage, and eMES development experience will stand out. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are required. Key Responsibilities: Product Ownership – Breyanzi MES Act as Product Owner for Breyanzi from an MES standpoint: own the product backlog, prioritize enhancements and fixes, and maintain the roadmap in alignment with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities and Tech Transfer stakeholders. Serve as the Breyanzi process subject matter expert for MES; capture and document detailed requirements and translate them into User Requirements, Functional and Design Specifications and test cases. Bridge the gap between process requirements and engineering build, ensuring requirements are fully translated into complete EBRs in MES that meet GMP compliance and regulatory expectations (including 21 CFR Part 11 and data integrity principles). Sprint and Project Management Lead Agile sprints in Jira for the Breyanzi book of work in a role similar to sprint manager, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, user story review and approval, sprint reviews and retrospectives. Maintain the project plan, including milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks and issues, and keep it current as scope and priorities change. Create and publish high-level project scorecards and status reports for IT and business leadership, covering progress against milestones, risks, and delivery health. Team Leadership, Review and Training Lead the Breyanzi MES sub-team, including offshore resources who may be early in their careers; assign work, set expectations, and track delivery. Review design, configuration and test work performed by developers; provide guidance and feedback on quality, optimizations and enhancements to EBRs and MES recipes/workflows. Train and onboard new engineers on the Breyanzi manufacturing process and MES build standards to build team capability and reduce reliance on individuals. Operations, Quality and Compliance Fully accountable for addressing production deviations and CAPA actions related to Breyanzi MES, including investigation, root cause analysis, corrective/preventive implementation and effectiveness checks. Provide primary application support for Breyanzi MES and serve on the on-call rotation to support L2 escalations for production issues. Maintain the validated state of the system through the change control process – creating changes in ServiceNow, obtaining pre-approval, executing/deploying changes, attaching evidence, closing tasks and obtaining post-approval. Participate in GMP validation activities including development and execution of IQ/OQ/PQ testing, and support software releases, audits and inspections. Identify and drive process and system improvements, standardization and reuse across Breyanzi EBRs and other manufacturing systems. Qualifications & Experience: Required Experience/Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience 5+ years of relevant industry experience in biopharmaceutical/cell therapy manufacturing and/or manufacturing IT systems Strong working knowledge of the Breyanzi manufacturing process (or comparable autologous cell therapy process) Hands-on experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems, preferably Syncade, including EBR design and build Experience leading or mentoring engineers, including offshore or junior team members, and translating business requirements into technical specifications Experience managing production deviations, investigations and CAPAs in a GMP environment Experience with electronic document management and quality management systems, and with change control and CSV/validation practices in regulated industries Technical writing competency and GMP procedure writing Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills Willingness to participate in on-call rotation for L2 production support Preferred Experience Prior experience developing in eMES Prior experience supporting commercial CAR T cell therapy manufacturing Experience with 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5 and data integrity requirements #LI-Onsite We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. Compensation Overview: Bothell - WA - US: $108,650 - $131,655 The starting pay range(s) listed above is for full-time employees (FTE). You may also be eligible for additional discretionary incentive cash and stock opportunities. We determine starting pay thoughtfully – carefully considering the nature of the role, required skills, work location, schedule and the knowledge and experience you bring. Final compensation is guided by pay equity principles and applicable employment laws. Compensation programs are reviewed on an ongoing basis and may be adjusted over time to reflect evolving market factors, and individual, team or Company performance. Benefits: Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, you may be eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefit plans – including wellbeing support, retirement and financial protection benefits, and insurance offerings (medical, dental, vision, life and disability). U.S.-based exempt employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off (FTO), which provides paid time off without a set accrual limit, subject to manager approval, along with 11 paid company holidays each year. Non-exempt employees, RayzeBio employees, and employees located in Puerto Rico receive 160 hours of paid vacation annually for new hires (subject to manager approval), 11 paid company holidays, and 3 optional holidays. Depending on eligibility, employees may also have access to additional time-off benefits, including paid sick leave, up to two paid volunteer days per year, summer hours flexibility, and leaves of absence for medical, personal, parental, caregiver, bereavement, or military needs. Eligible employees also enjoy an annual Global Shutdown between Christmas Day and New Year's Day. jobs.title: Clinical Data Operator - Austin, TX
jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: On site position in Austin, TX Clinical Data Operator accessions patient samples according to standard operating procedures (SOP) with high efficiency and accuracy. Hourly rate starts at $18. Shift Options: Tuesday - Saturday, 7am-330pm Hourly rate starts at $18 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES * Front-end lab operations* - Receive, sort, and transport packages from the shipping dock and reception to the Accessioning lab, and scan tracking numbers accurately. - Open, prep, and de-kit samples, checking that paperwork matches samples and that no PHI or samples remain in discarded kit boxes. - Rack bulk samples and distribute work to stations according to distribution guidelines. - Support sample pickup, consolidation, and send-outs. - Scan requisitions, bench worksheets, and supporting documents, and upload them to the correct case. - File, store, and dispose of requisition forms according to retention requirements. - Empty bins, carts, trash, and biohazard containers, and keep workstations and lab areas clean and organized. * Case creation and data entry* - Capture requisition and case information using intelligent document processing (IDP) tools such as Fusion. - As trained: create new orders in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), enter and review patient data, and keep records accurate and up to date. - As trained: accession samples across product types with high accuracy and efficiency. * Quality, safety, and compliance* - Handle samples (blood, buccal, and tissue) and package-opening tools safely and correctly. - Escalate packaging issues, discrepancies, or quality concerns to Leads or Supervisors. - Follow SOPs, quality standards, and safety requirements, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE). - This role works with PHI regularly in both paper and electronic form, and has access to various technologies to access PHI in order to do the job. Protect PHI at all times in line with HIPAA and privacy policies. - Complete HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance, and security training as soon as possible, and no later than 30 days after hire. - Maintain current status on all Natera training requirements. - Perform other duties as assigned. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT ** - Stand and walk for most of the shift, up to 8–10 hours. - Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs regularly, including boxes, totes, and loaded carts. - Bend, reach, stoop, and kneel repeatedly. - Perform repetitive hand and wrist motions, including scanning, opening packages, and typing. - Work in a clinical lab environment with possible exposure to biological samples and biohazardous materials, using required PPE. - Work in a fast-paced, high-volume, deadline-driven environment. - Be flexible for shift changes, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on business needs. * *QUALIFICATIONS** - High school diploma (or equivalent) required. - 0–1 year of experience in a lab, warehouse, logistics, healthcare, or data entry setting preferred. - Previous computer experience required. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** - Strong attention to detail and accuracy in high-volume, physical work. - Willingness to do hands-on tasks of every kind as part of a team. - Ability to learn several workflows and systems, and build toward full accessioning. - Typing speed of at least 45 wpm with high accuracy, or the ability to reach it during training. - Good oral and written communication skills, and sound judgment. - Reliable, organized, self-motivated, and able to work well with others. OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com . Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes. For more information: - BBB announcement on job scams - FBI Cyber Crime resource page

jobs.title: Manager, Analytical Engineer
jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Our Team: The Global Product Development and Supply (GPS) Analytics & AI Enablement (A&AIE) team within Business Insights and Technology (BI&T) partners with the Bristol Myers Squibb GPS organization to support data models for all functions within GPS. The team focuses on creating and maintaining the core GPS data layer to enable data models to support answering key business questions that will drive prioritized business decisions using advanced analytics and data science. The GPS organization at Bristol Myers Squibb supports drug development from discovery through commercialization and distribution to patients. Their scope includes portfolio strategy, manufacturing and distribution, network strategy, brand analytics, drug substance, drug product, and analytical development for small molecules, biologics, and cell therapy assets. Job Description: The Manager of Analytics Engineering provides hands-on technical expertise to develop, deploy, and maintain both core data models and core data layer infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building robust, scalable, and well-documented data models and pipelines, while also enabling self-service analytics across the organization. We are seeking a highly skilled Analytical Engineer to join our team. This role bridges the gap between data engineering and data analytics, focusing on data architecture, quality, and governance. The ideal candidate will have experience designing and maintaining dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas), including fact and dimension table design, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and conformed dimensions across multiple subject areas. This role requires strong technical expertise in data transformation, modeling, and pipeline optimization. Additionally, a successful candidate is an excellent communicator who can effectively explain complex technical information to a wide variety of stakeholders. Key Responsibilities and Major Duties Collaborate with the business to gather requirements and deliver data-products to enable data-informed decision-making. Develop a centralized data-layer to deliver data-products at scale to the business. Incorporating domain-specific data marts into a centralized, foundational core. Harmonize data across manufacturing sites, software, and platforms for enterprise-level consumption. Designing highly organized and scalable architectural solutions to drive efficiency. Define orchestration strategies across multiple data domains. Work within a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement. Work within Data Build Tool (dbt) to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t-repeat-yourself”) code. Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data to internal consumers on-time. Focus on innovative solutions to increase speed-to-delivery and accelerate business decision-making. Qualifications/Degree/Certification/Licensure BA/BS or higher required Computer Science, Physics, Math, Data Science, Pharmaceutical Science, or Engineering area of study preferred Minimum 4 years experience working in analytical or data field Proficiency with SQL Experience scripting (e.g. Python/R) Working knowledge of DAG-based and asset-based pipeline design Experience with version control (e.g. Git, SVN) and Agile development Proven analytical and problem-solving ability Experience working in or alongside agile/scrum teams highly desired Expertise gathering requirements to understand business needs and define technical solutions Excellent communications and presentation skills. Ability to explain complex analyses and outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Hands-on experience with dbt a plus Familiarity with our toolkit desired: work information process tools (JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, MS suites); data-related tools (Databricks, DBT) Why you should apply You will help patients in their fight against serious diseases You will be part of a company that encourages excellence and innovation, respects diversity, develops leaders and values its employees. You’ll get a competitive salary and a great benefits package including, but not only, an annual bonus, pension contribution, family health insurance, 27 days of annual leave , access to BMS Cruiserath on-site gym and life assurance #LI-Hybrid We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. How We Work Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways-of-working. Supporting People with Disabilities BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com . Visit careers.bms.com/eeo-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement. Candidate Rights BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area. For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california-residents/ For roles based in Washington State only: If you live in or expect to work from Washington State if hired for this position, please visit this page for important information about the Washington Fair Chance Act. Data Protection We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud-protection . Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations. jobs.title: Cloud Network Engineer
jobs.description: Career Category Information Systems Job Description Join our team at AMGEN Capability Center Portugal , consistently recognized among the top companies in the Best Workplaces™ ranking by Great Place to Work® in Portugal. In 2026, we were once again distinguished as one of the top Best Workplaces in the country (category 201–500 employees), reinforcing our commitment to an exceptional employee experience and workplace culture. We are a team of over 500 talented individuals, spanning more than 30 functions and areas of expertise, and representing over 40 nationalities. Together, we bring diverse perspectives and professional backgrounds to help shape the future of healthcare through innovation and technology. This is your opportunity to explore a world of possibilities across areas such as Data & Analytics, Digital, Technology & Innovation, Cybersecurity, R&D Operations, Global Distribution, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, General & Administrative, Human Resources, and many more. Located in the heart of Lisbon, our AMGEN office fosters a culture of innovation, excellence, and purpose. Come thrive with us at AMGEN, supporting our mission To Serve Patients. What we do at AMGEN matters in people’s lives. Cloud Network Engineer At AMGEN, Technology isn’t just a support function—it’s a catalyst for discovery, transformation, and real-world impact. Here, your ideas fuel innovation that improves and saves lives of patients in dire need of our medicines. Are you ready to do meaningful work that matters? LIVE WHAT YOU WILL DO We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Network Engineer to join the Cloud Networking team and help design, implement, operate, and continuously improve a large-scale enterprise AWS network environment. This role will be responsible for delivering secure, resilient, scalable, and highly available cloud-networking capabilities across a multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. The engineer will work across AWS networking, enterprise network integration, cloud security, DNS, routing, connectivity, and application enablement. The successful candidate will bring strong hands-on experience with AWS networking and a solid foundation in enterprise networking technologies. This person must be comfortable troubleshooting complex end-to-end connectivity issues involving AWS, on-premises infrastructure, routing protocols, firewalls, DNS, and application dependencies. The position will work closely with Cloud Platform, Enterprise Network, Cybersecurity/Network Security, Infrastructure, application engineering, and other technology teams. Roles & Responsibilities: Cloud Network Architecture & Engineering Design, implement, and support cloud network architectures across AWS and/or other major cloud platforms, with AWS experience preferred. Work with AWS networking services such as Amazon VPC, Transit Gateway, subnetting, route tables, VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, and Route 53 ; equivalent Azure or GCP experience will also be considered. Implement secure and scalable multi-account, multi-region, and hybrid-cloud networking patterns. Develop and maintain cloud network standards, reusable architectures, and engineering patterns. Support network segmentation and controlled traffic flows across application, platform, shared-service, and security domains. Participate in architecture reviews and provide cloud-networking guidance for new applications and platform migrations. Hybrid Connectivity Design, implement, and troubleshoot connectivity between cloud and enterprise/on-premises environments. Work with private connectivity services, Site-to-Site VPN, BGP, route propagation, routing domains, and hybrid connectivity patterns . AWS Direct Connect experience is preferred. Troubleshoot complex traffic paths across cloud environments, enterprise routing, firewalls, and security controls. Partner with Enterprise Network teams on cloud/on-premises routing boundaries and connectivity changes. DNS & Network Services Implement and support cloud DNS and network services, including Route 53/Route 53 Resolver or equivalent Azure/GCP services , private hosted zones, inbound/outbound DNS resolution, and hybrid DNS architectures. Troubleshoot DNS resolution issues across cloud and enterprise environments. Support cloud network services such as private endpoints, PrivateLink or equivalent services, load balancing, and private API connectivity. Security Integration Implement cloud-networking solutions aligned with enterprise security requirements. Work with firewall and security teams to design and troubleshoot inspected traffic flows. Support network segmentation, security groups or equivalent cloud controls, NACLs, endpoint controls, and secure connectivity patterns. Ensure network designs follow enterprise security and least-privilege principles. Operations & Incident Management Provide senior-level troubleshooting for production incidents, service requests, and network onboarding activities. Participate in major incident response, root-cause analysis, problem management, and preventive engineering. Analyze routing, DNS, firewalls, cloud security controls, endpoints, TCP/IP, and connectivity behavior to isolate network versus application/service issues. Support operational readiness, change management, documentation, and network lifecycle activities. Resilience, Capacity & Continuous Improvement Identify single points of failure and improve network resiliency and operational continuity. Contribute to capacity planning, growth forecasting, lifecycle management, and disaster-recovery/network recovery strategies. Help reduce key-person dependency through documentation, knowledge sharing, standardization, and team development. Continuously improve network reliability, observability, operational processes, and engineering practices. WIN WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU Basic Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 3+ years of relevant experience , or equivalent combination of education and experience. Must-Have Skills: Strong hands-on experience designing and operating AWS networking infrastructure in enterprise environments . Significant experience with: AWS VPC Transit Gateway Route tables and routing Direct Connect and/or Site-to-Site VPN Route 53 and DNS VPC endpoints / PrivateLink Security Groups and Network ACLs Strong understanding of IPv4, TCP/IP, subnetting, CIDR, routing, DNS, and network troubleshooting . Experience with infrastructure automation using CloudFormation, Terraform, Python, Bash, or AWS CLI . Practical experience with enterprise routing technologies such as BGP and/or OSPF . Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex hybrid-cloud connectivity issues. Experience working in environments with multiple teams, accounts, platforms, and organizational dependencies. Ability to participate in production support and critical incident response when required. Good-to-Have Skills: AWS networking certification such as AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty . Experience with AWS Organizations and large-scale multi-account environments. Experience with multi-region AWS networking. Experience integrating AWS networking with enterprise firewalls such as Fortinet, Palo Alto, or equivalent . Experience with cloud security architecture and network segmentation. Experience with centralized DNS and hybrid DNS architectures. Experience with infrastructure automation using CloudFormation, Terraform, Python, Bash, or AWS CLI . Experience with observability and network diagnostics including VPC Flow Logs, CloudWatch, packet captures, and network telemetry . Experience supporting regulated or highly controlled enterprise environments. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical issues to both engineers and leadership. Soft Skills: Strong ownership and accountability. Able to work independently on technically complex problems. Calm and analytical during production incidents. Strong collaboration across Cloud, Network, Security, Infrastructure, and Application teams. Willingness to document and transfer knowledge rather than becoming a single point of dependency. Strong engineering judgment and risk awareness. Ability to balance operational support with long-term architectural improvement. THRIVE WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT OF US Vast opportunities to learn, develop, and move up and across our global organization. Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where colleagues are empowered to bring ideas to the table, take risks, and act. Generous Amgen Total Rewards Plan comprising healthcare, finance, wealth, and career benefits. Flexible work arrangements. APPLY NOW Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us. cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Field Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Field Specialist opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

Best,
Celina Lin

You'll build the models and dashboards yourself and use Claude to automate as much of the reporting as you can. Key responsibilities: Own the plan. jobs.title: Member of Data Staff (Data Acceleration)
jobs.description: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. This role brings that same standard to how our data team works, with AI at the center of everything we do. We're looking for someone who's been a great data scientist, analytics engineer, or data engineer: the kind of person who knows which metric actually matters, can design an A/B test that answers the real question, has gone deep on a data model because something didn't add up, and has decided that the highest-leverage thing they can do next is build AI systems that fundamentally change how data science gets done. You'll build AI agents and internal systems that can increasingly handle end-to-end analysis workflows: forming hypotheses, writing and running queries, interpreting results, and drafting recommendations with the right evaluation, review, and guardrails. You'll build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let AI systems query the warehouse reliably. You'll create workflows that detect, diagnose, and help fix data issues before they become company-wide problems. You'll build the infrastructure that multiplies what a small data team can ship. You'll join a data team that's already using AI across its work. The next step is turning those individual workflows into scalable systems, shared tools, and an AI-native operating model that becomes a benchmark for how modern data teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build AI agents that do data science - not just SQL copilots, but systems that can safely explore data, form hypotheses, run queries, interpret results, and generate actionable recommendations with clear evaluation and human review loops. - Make AI systems query the warehouse reliably - build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let agents use our semantic context and metadata accurately. - Accelerate the AI-native data workflow - turn the best existing AI-assisted workflows into repeatable systems, reusable tools, and patterns the whole data team can adopt. - Automate the data lifecycle - build self-healing pipelines, automated dbt model generation and validation, data quality agents, and diagnosis workflows that reduce manual firefighting. - Ship AI-powered experiment analysis - build agents that interpret A/B test results, flag statistical issues, identify likely drivers, and draft ship/no-ship recommendations. - Turn the data team into a product team - build internal data products that stakeholders use every day, replacing ad hoc requests with self-serve AI interfaces. - Own the full lifecycle - identify high-leverage problems, prototype with LLMs, evaluate accuracy, design the UX, ship to production, and monitor quality over time. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in data science, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. You've been close enough to real data work to know what should and should not be automated. - Deep SQL and analytics judgment - you can reason through metrics, experiments, data models, and messy warehouse reality without relying on a tool to think for you. - Strong product sense - you understand what stakeholders actually need, what makes a workflow adoptable, and how to turn a prototype into a product people use. - Hands-on LLM experience - you've built with frontier models, agents, RAG systems, evals, or AI-powered workflows and have opinions about where they work and where they fail. - Pipeline and modeling fluency - you've worked with dbt, warehouse schemas, data quality issues, and the practical tradeoffs behind durable data systems. - Builder mentality - you see a manual process and immediately think about how to systematize it. You ship fast, measure quality, and iterate. - Autonomy - this is a new function. You'll help define the roadmap as much as execute it. BONUS - Experience building production AI agents or agent evaluation systems. - Experience with Snowflake, semantic layers, or metadata systems. - Experience building internal tools, Slack bots, CLIs, or developer productivity products that people actually used. - Strong experimentation background, including metric design and statistical interpretation. - Experience with BI tools and the judgment to know what should be automated versus kept human-reviewed. - Early-stage startup experience. WHY THIS ROLE - Set the standard for the industry - Perplexity's data team is already using AI across its work. You'll turn that into something other data teams look to as the benchmark. - Build AI with AI - Perplexity builds AI for people who expect more. You'll bring that same level of ambition to how the company works with data. - Frontier models, day one - you're at an AI company with access to frontier infrastructure and people who deeply understand what's possible. - Massive leverage - the systems you build will multiply the output of every data team member and every stakeholder who needs data. - Direct impact - small team, no layers of approval. Idea to shipped system in days, not quarters.

Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Position Location: Lisbon, Portugal or London, UK (Hybrid) Citizenship: U.S. or UK Citizenship Required (due to government security clearance requirements) About the Role We are looking for a dedicated Program/Project Manager to spearhead the execution of mission-critical federal technology engagements within our Government Projects team. In this role, you will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and agency partners to convert complex technical roadmaps into structured initiatives, driving projects seamlessly from initial business cases through final deployment and operational readiness. This position demands a blend of program leadership, strong relationship management, and deep technical familiarity with networking and cybersecurity infrastructure in public sector settings. We believe that putting our people first and fostering a creative, exciting, and stimulating environment is a prerequisite to achieving and surpassing our goals. cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate, Regulatory Business Capabilities — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate, Regulatory Business Capabilities opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Sr Associate Compound Operations & Informatic at Amgen Research Copenhagen, Denmark (Parental cover)
jobs.description: Career Category Operations Job Description HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION? At Amgen, our shared mission – to serve patients – drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies, reaching over 10 million patients worldwide. Amgen Research Copenhagen (ARC) is, through our DNA Encoded Library (DEL) technology, contributing significantly to Amgen’s many small molecule drug discovery projects from hit discovery all the way to drug candidate selection. Recently, Amgen has committed significantly to drive innovation within the Induced Proximity Platform, charged with developing Amgen’s newest drug modalities aimed at expanding the druggable genome through the use of Proximity Biology. The DEL technology at ARC is at the core of hit and lead discovery within many of these efforts. Come do your best work alongside other innovative, driven professionals in this thrilling and meaningful role. Fixed term Senior Associate Compound Operations & Informatic at Amgen Research Copenhagen, Denmark WHAT YOU WILL DO For this vital role, we are seeking a skilled Life sciences graduate to take part in a dynamic and results-oriented team at Amgen Research Copenhagen (ARC), with responsibilities including, but not limited to, supporting Compound Operations and Informatic team (COI), local at ARC as well as Amgen International Research Material Management (RMM), and maintaining continuous and reliable collaboration between stakeholders, peers and key suppliers. Furthermore, you will assist in implementing the Global Research tactical strategy and timelines. The work is conducted within cross-functional teams and in coordination with colleagues in the US. The position primarily facilitates the prompt and precise execution of R&D activities, supports process enhancement efforts, and oversees general building maintenance activities. You will be a member of Compound Operations and Informatic team (COI). This is a fixed term assignment of 12 months. Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Associate Compound Operations & Informatic at Amgen Research Copenhagen, Denmark (Parental cover) opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

You will play a crucial role in translating business priorities into the systems, processes, and business rules needed to bring new commercial initiatives to life and scale existing motions. You will lead cross-functional planning, define business requirements, align stakeholders, and drive delivery with business and technical partners. Your work will connect teams across the customer lifecycle, ensure operational readiness, and measure whether implemented solutions achieve their intended business outcomes. You will play a crucial part in helping the organization deliver on its growth strategy. You’ll build partnerships across GTM functions and see the direct impact of your work on revenue execution and the customer and seller experience. Responsibilities Translate strategy into execution: Turn revenue-driving strategies into actionable plans across GTM systems, processes, and business rules. Define business requirements: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, document requirements, and establish clear success criteria. Lead cross-functional delivery: Manage programs from discovery through implementation, coordinating scope, timelines, dependencies, and accountable owners. Drive solution development: Partner with business and technical teams to evaluate options, resolve gaps, and implement scalable solutions. Align stakeholders and decisions: Facilitate discussions, clarify tradeoffs, and drive agreement on priorities, ownership, and outstanding decisions. Ensure operational readiness: Coordinate testing, documentation, and change management to support successful launches and adoption. Measure outcomes and improve: Track results against business objectives, identify operational gaps, and drive improvements to execution and the customer and seller experience. Requirements At least 3 years of overall professional experience. 3 + years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives. Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market. Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process workflows, and measurable success criteria. Experience partnering with technical and business teams to evaluate solutions, assess tradeoffs, and validate that changes meet business needs. Ability to identify root causes, use data to assess outcomes, and implement practical improvements that scale. Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, billing, commerce, provisioning, entitlement, or other systems supporting the quote-to-cash/customer lifecycle. Understanding of the customer lifecycle and how systems, processes, data, and business rules support commercial execution. Familiarity with automation and AI capabilities that can simplify requirements gathering, dependency management, testing, and operational readiness.
